title: Factor P104 lifting defects through 201 exact real output channels
body:
The fixed rank-seven P104 integer-lifting correction uses 256 real output coordinates. This package factors it through an exact 201-channel real output interface with a sufficient 1910-bit integral Walsh packet, while explicitly charging a restored delivery circuit. It changes the correction output representation; PR3035/3037's 343-bit input-period code is a separate contract.

A written all-rank Walsh argument gives output-span upper dimension `2^(r+1)-F_(r+3)`. Actual integer witnesses attain it for ranks 1..7 (`1,3,8,19,43,94,201`), using two internal implementations, different source schedules and primes 65537/65521. The rank-seven minimum is for a fixed real-linear decoder; there is no bit-information, nonlinear-decoder or general circuit lower bound.

The packet decodes exactly as `D=Hc`. The complete arbitrary-target XOR delivery macro word restores all clean work and pays **7676 signed modular ADDs, 3072 target CNOTs, 27648 clean-bank bits**, plus its 1910-bit source and 3072-bit target. Modular ADD lowering, sign-extension/carry ancillas, encoded production, the exact wide backend, source access, physical routing and recursive-child costs remain additional. The unchanged 448 narrow pair sites are retained. **No favorable complete recursive comparison, supplier admission, selected-frontier change or new kappa is claimed.**

[Proof, scope, sources, invoice and next questions](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9e808b67bc395dc91b55493a6fdce0863240bf1c/research/p104-defect-output-channels/README.md). [Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2750#discussioncomment-18983489). Scientific base main `d8e0f83f00191df62174b641e9fff055c357f641`, priority 6.

Validation: registered CPython 3.12.12 replay; separate optimized internal checker; seven behavioral groups including complete rank-one source/target coverage, phase/channel faults, output-invisible cleanup omission, signed widening and source/typed-receipt failures. All three commands also pass optimized CPython 3.14.6 in a read-only Git-free export. The primary replay includes 625 signed pair-source cases, 42 full-word source comparisons, 84 arbitrary-target delivery fixtures and 210 dirty-buffer consumer fixtures. Exact committed package/input bytes pass. A separate internal mathematical specialist rederived the proof and reviewed signed widths, literal cleanup and every delivery count. No independent human/formal-kernel review or hosted CI pass is claimed.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-defect-output-channels
```

Only `research/p104-defect-output-channels/` is added. Credit Tekalign/PR3025/3033, Nick Petalas/PR3035/3037, Ross Richardson/PR3043/3059, Arham Tahir/PR3046, ywz65 and the retained P104/native lineage. The sole vendored source is byte-identical PR3033 `vendor/lifting.py` at `b12bbaeb5ca2e83f15433fc2dd0ba3b766595281`. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including the separate internal mathematical reviewer; Apache-2.0. No frozen source, shared checker or maintainer priority change.

Submission overlap: complete pagination covered 310 open PR bodies including drafts, 1821 Discussion records and 2440 closed/merged PR bodies (21:41–21:43 UTC, 2026-10-16). Snapshots are non-atomic and omit arbitrary diffs and unpublished work; no novelty proof is inferred. Named predecessor heads are unchanged.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way. Isolated opt-in research package.

**Blast Radius:** research. Output-channel and finite witness claims retain their stated premises; no selected construction changes.
